caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a metal and wood tool or component, set against a plain, light beige background. The object has an upper section that appears bulbous and rounded, with a brownish, wood-like texture and subtle shading suggesting three-dimensionality. Directly beneath this section, there is a collar section, after which a dark, metallic, curved pipe or rod extends downward in a semi-circular arc before making a sharp right-angle turn and ending with a cylindrical extension at the bottom. The metallic section is rendered in darker brown and grayish tones, with shading indicating its cylindrical structure and curvature. The lower portion of the object is relatively straight, contrasting with the more ornate, rounded top. The entire object is positioned vertically in the center of the composition with significant empty space around it. In the lower right corner, the name "Alonso Mohedano" and the date "1786" are inscribed in small text.
title: Bit Brace
